$meta.name: NotificationType
$meta.description: Every notification kind the server can emit. Drives the notification inbox, the push payload `type`, and the per-type preference matrix.
$meta.ownerNote: The server is the only emitter, so it decides what exists. A type a client cannot name is still delivered — it just renders with a generic label, which is why `onUnknown` is preserve.

provenance.seededFrom: babel-lambda-api/src/notifications/types.ts — `export type NotificationType` (lines 6-177). Order preserved: it is domain-grouped and the grouping is load-bearing for the preference UI.
provenance.crossCheck: Identical SET to the keys of CHANNEL_DEFAULTS (channel-defaults.ts:24-175), in a different order. CHANNEL_DEFAULTS is a total Record<NotificationType, …>, so the compiler already ties those two together.

drift.api: 124 (types.ts union === CHANNEL_DEFAULTS keys as a set)
drift.mobile: 129 enum constants in lib/common/enums/notification_type.dart — a SUPERSET: it names every server type plus 3 retired maintenance_* ones, a client-local garbage_reminder, and an `unknown` parse sentinel
drift.admin: 79 in TYPE_GROUPS (notifications-utils.ts) — a strict SUBSET, every one of them a real server type
drift.adminGap: 45 server types have no TYPE_GROUPS entry, so they are invisible on the web preference screen and unsettable there. Admin has no "other" bucket; mobile does (isUncategorized).
drift.apiInternal: NOTIFICATION_TITLES / NOTIFICATION_BODIES in src/i18n/notifications.ts are Record<string, …>, NOT keyed to the union, so they are the one place the API can drift from itself: 112 bodies for 124 types, and titles keyed by English display strings ("Payment Due") rather than slugs.

excluded.note: Deliberately NOT canon. A consumer migrating to this contract must keep these locally rather than delete them.
excluded.garbage_reminder: A mobile-LOCAL notification scheduled on-device by garbage_reminder_scheduler.dart. It never crosses the API boundary, so it is not a contract — but mobile must keep it.
excluded.unknown: A Dart parse sentinel for forward compatibility, not a wire value. Never send or store it.

deprecatedNote: Not emitted for new notifications and absent from the API union and CHANNEL_DEFAULTS, but still present in the API's NOTIFICATION_BODIES map (src/i18n/notifications.ts:1514,1523,1532) and in mobile's enum — so stored rows can still carry them. Readers must accept; writers must not emit.
